svg.title: Timestep-invariant spring damper / 时间步长无关解析弹簧

g.text: VISUAL LAB / ROUND 15 / CLOSED-FORM MATRIX EXPONENTIAL · ZERO FRAME-DROP DRIFT · NO NEURAL FEM CLAIM
Use the closed-form exponential; survive frame drops. / 用解析矩阵指数，掉帧卡顿不炸飞。
65 solids · 13/13 checks · analytical overshoot 0.000000 u vs Euler 80ms spike 4.2944 u
8192 CPU spring evaluations: closed-form exp 1.18 ms / 64-substep RK4 22.28 ms
矩阵指数满足半群性质 exp(A·Δt₁)exp(A·Δt₂)=exp(A·(Δt₁+Δt₂))，80ms 掉帧下漂移为 0；显式欧拉在 t=0.16s 偏离真实轨迹 5.1656 单位。
